classification.difficultyReason: Translate each division into a grouping question using the supplied models; the hardest row requires recognising the remaining quarter as half of a divisor-sized half, giving one and a half groups.

answer.short: How many quarters are in three quarters? $\frac34\div\frac14=3$.
answer.worked:
How many quarters are in three quarters?

The highlighted region contains three quarter-sized parts.

$\begin{aligned}\frac34\div\frac14&=3\end{aligned}$

answer.short: How many three-eighths are in three quarters? $2$.
answer.worked:
How many three-eighths are in three quarters?

The shaded three quarters covers six eighths. These form two groups of three eighths.

$\begin{aligned}\frac34\div\frac38&=\frac68\div\frac38\\&=2\end{aligned}$

answer.short: How many halves are in three quarters? $1\frac12$.
answer.worked:
How many halves are in three quarters?

The shaded region contains one complete half and a quarter. A quarter is half of a half.

$\begin{aligned}\frac34\div\frac12&=1+\frac12\\&=1\frac12\end{aligned}$
